title: Training record
description: Proof that one person completed one AI literacy or role-based module, with the assessment result and the access it unlocks. Pseudonymous by design: the record carries a person reference, not a name.
$comment: AI Governance Engineer templates and schemas library, v1. CC BY 4.0 (attribution: Jorge García Aibar). x-evidences names the obligations a field or record helps evidence: an illustrative mapping, not a claim of conformity and not legal advice. https://aigovernanceengineer.com/resources/templates

$schema.description: The URI of this schema, so a record says what it claims to be.

person_ref.description: Pseudonymous reference to the person in the HR or identity system. Never a name in shared evidence.

role.description: Role the training is for (for example "credit analyst, oversight").

module_id.description: Module completed, as listed in the literacy curriculum.

curriculum_version.description: Version of the curriculum the module belongs to.

assessment.description: Assessment result, if the module is assessed.

attestation.description: Policy acknowledgement collected with the training.

policy.description: Policy acknowledged (for example the acceptable-use policy).

grants.description: Access or duties the record unlocks (for example "override in credit-afford-03"). Access checks read this field.

valid_until.description: Expiry; refresher due before this date.

delivered_by.description: Who delivered it (internal team or provider).

extensions.description: Organisation-specific fields. Validators ignore their content; keep evidence-bearing fields in the core record.
